company_name: Zhejiang Xinhui Equipment Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end intelligent equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhejiang Xinhui Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. provides advanced equipment and services for wafer grinding, polishing, and chip testing in the semiconductor industry. Founded in 2018, the company aims to deliver innovative technology and stable product solutions to domestic semiconductor customers.

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Haining Pan-semiconductor Industrial Park, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, and is investing significantly in local semiconductor infrastructure.
